spec_match.rationale: Classifies pasted markup's target attributes against the four keywords and same-document frame names — the migration tool the removal calls for — plus a live underscore-name resolution proof.

interactive.rationale: Audit, restore-sample and the resolution-proof button all work on real DOM parsing and a real navigation.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the audit-your-own-markup promise including the case-insensitivity trap.

edge_cases.rationale: Case-insensitive keyword matching, window.open and form target positions, names that merely look reserved.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Audited the sample and a custom paste; proof navigation behaved as standard on this build; console clean.

accessibility.rationale: Textarea labelled and controls fine; same iframe-focus caveat on the proof frame.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite passes 4/4 on this build — the removal has shipped here, so _current resolves as an ordinary name.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; secondary buttons override both background and color.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. A genuinely useful migration audit backed by live resolution proof.
